required: Genuine semantic adoption of the exact N_style and N_history controls.
A separately justified and prospectively calibrated inferential procedure, or an explicitly estimation-only confirmatory freeze.
A viable selected model, passed disjoint C0 gate, interpretable development factorial, and frozen independent cohort.

analysis_rules.aggregation: Average the two case contributions within each speaker, then weight the 48 speakers equally. Preserve template identifiers for crossed-cluster sensitivity.
analysis_rules.cluster_sensitivity: Speaker-cluster and two-way speaker/template intervals remain labeled sensitivity analyses; neither is a calibrated confirmatory test at this checkpoint.
analysis_rules.complete_pair: Report complete-pair estimates, their case/speaker/template coverage, and missingness by condition as secondary selected-subset sensitivity only.
analysis_rules.identification_bounds: Always report all-eligible logical bounds when required cells are unknown. Bounds are not confidence intervals.
analysis_rules.identified_point: Report the all-eligible point only when every active cell is known. No confirmatory p-value is authorized because both prospective marginal-test calibrations failed.
analysis_rules.no_reweighting: Never drop unknown cells and renormalize surviving factorial weights.
analysis_rules.no_single_imputation: Do not replace unknowns with failure, success, parser output, reviewer consensus, or a model prediction.
analysis_rules.primary_missingness_analysis: Apply original signed contrast weights over all eligible cases with endpoint range [0,1]; unknown cells contribute logical lower and upper limits according to weight sign.

endpoint_rules.automatic_parser: Automatic aliases and structural status remain separate diagnostics and cannot impute a missing human semantic endpoint.
endpoint_rules.current_value_adoption: CURRENT_VALUE_ADOPTION=1; every determinate mutually exclusive non-current semantic state=0; UNCERTAIN or missing review=unknown.
endpoint_rules.full_distribution: Primary descriptive accounting reports every semantic category, including UNCERTAIN and NO_REQUESTED_VALUE, on the frozen eligible denominator.
endpoint_rules.outdated_value_adoption: OUTDATED_VALUE_ADOPTION=1; every determinate mutually exclusive non-outdated semantic state=0; UNCERTAIN or missing review=unknown.
endpoint_rules.semantic_completeness: COMPLETE and INCOMPLETE remain observed categories; UNCERTAIN or unavailable review remains unknown for a binary completeness estimand.

inferential_boundary.effect: Signed identification bounds remain valid; hypothesis-test adoption remains blocked.

reporting_requirements: Counts for execution failure, integrity failure, review missingness, semantic UNCERTAIN, and each observed semantic category by condition.
Required-cell, complete-case, speaker, and template coverage for every contrast.
All-eligible logical bounds beside any complete-pair sensitivity estimate.
Reasons and hashes for any preregistered retry; original failed attempts remain preserved.
Separate sampling uncertainty, identification uncertainty, annotation disagreement, and model stochasticity.
Report N_style and N_history execution/review missingness separately from factorial cells.
Do not activate a neutral-control contrast merely because its mathematical weights are available.

scope.condition: The two contrasts activate only if their exact neutral controls receive prospective semantic adoption.
scope.extension: Adds C1-N_style and C3-N_history to the nine V1 signed-bound contrasts.
scope.historical_effect: No historical output, label, gate, score, eligibility decision, or estimand is changed.

state_classification.completed_generation_with_empty_or_nonan: Observed model outcome; semantically label NO_REQUESTED_VALUE when supported by genuine review, not administrative missingness.
state_classification.completed_generation_with_uncertain_sema: Observed UNCERTAIN category; unknown for latent current/outdated binary indicators.
state_classification.infrastructure_or_resource_failure_witho: Administrative missing outcome; never a model failure, success, or semantic nonanswer.
state_classification.lost_or_hash_invalid_raw_output: Integrity missingness; retain the incident and do not score reconstructed text.
state_classification.not_applicable: Allowed only when applicability was frozen before outcomes; report separately and never use it for an applicable failed assessment.
state_classification.unreviewed_or_unresolved_response: Measurement missingness; retain model text but treat the semantic endpoint as unknown.
